citationText: 15. Digital Cinema Initiatives , LLC (DCI) was created in March 2002 , and is a joint venture of Disney, Fox, Paramount, Sony Pictures Entertainment, Universal, and Warner Bros, studios. DCI's primary purpose is to establish and document voluntary specifications for an open architecture for digital cinema that ensures a uniform and high level of technical performance, reliability and quality control. See http://www.dcimovies.com/ .
